methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Gleb Tsipursky | Virginia’s AI training needs a first job at the other end - Augusta Free Press
signals.signal_reading: Training workers for AI roles without corresponding job infrastructure creates a skills-employment mismatch that signals shallow adoption—people trained but no depth of implementation to absorb them, particularly outside metro hubs.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: A community-driven initiative to evaluate AI adoption across the Roanoke Valley signals distributed capacity-building through local networks rather than platform dependency, though depth remains to be proven.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: A specialized WorkAI Lab at Roanoke College creates deep institutional AI capability but concentration at the college level may not distribute broadly through the regional economy without intentional workforce pipelines.

signals.title: UpMax Details AI Transformation Practice for Everyday Operations - norfolkneradio.com
signals.signal_reading: A consulting practice focused on AI transformation for 'everyday operations' in Hampton Roads signals platform-mediated shallow adoption—businesses consuming AI tools without building internal technical depth.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: A governor-ordered statewide cybersecurity response to AI threats concentrates defensive capability in state government infrastructure while unclear whether preparedness distributes to smaller jurisdictions and rural areas.
